**Severity:** error · **Area:** Syntax / JSX / attributes (`RV1xxx`) · **Quick fix:** yes

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
Textarea model cannot also have children
```

## How to fix

Self-close the `<textarea>`: `model:value` supplies its content.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
declare const v: any;
export const A = () => <textarea model:value={v}>x</textarea>;
```

```tsx prefer
declare const v: any;
export const A = () => <textarea model:value={v} />;
```

## Quick fix

The [language service](../guides/tooling/language-service.md) (editor) and the MCP `check_code` tool offer this code action:

- Remove the textarea children (model supplies the value)
